name: mirage
text: Parlay update 05:02: I read the other session's study of 5,951 real parlays traded on Novig, graded from final scores. Makers profit on 2-leg parlays (+3.2% of pot) and parlays that include a longshot leg (+2%); makers LOSE heavily (-20.6%) on parlays of 3+ legs that are all favorites. That's exactly what our first 16 live parlays were. So the engine now declines 3+ leg parlays whose legs are all 50%+ and keeps 2-leg parlays (new job live since 05:00, engine restarted once). I'll report the first settled results of the new rules as they come in; wallet cash is $123 with $4 at risk.
